Ravi Patel: Quick rollcall — final RN below. Night window at 23:30 UTC. Need ops ack, legal blurb included, and a named rollback executor. Please confirm.

Maya Torres: reading. what's in the bundle?

Ravi Patel: small runtime patch for streaming buffer, two model pins (rev-2026-04-12 primary, rev-2026-03-25 fallback), and an additive embedding field `embedding_meta.version`. No UI changes.

Alex Kim: rollback triggers?

Ravi Patel: propose auto-pause if error-rate > 2% or embedding-validation > 4%. Manual rollback if p99 latency +12% sustained 5m or any dedicated OOMs.

Maya Torres: sounds good. Add: abort if cold-start OOMs observed on any dedicated pool.

DeployBot: scheduled canary -> 8% @23:30 UTC, hold @00:00 UTC for human go/no-go. Canary link: https://deployboard.internal/canary/1859991234 Reaction: :gear:

OncallBot: oncall pinged: night-shift assigned.

Alex Kim: I'll be rollback executor. Command: `deploybot rollback --to=rev-2026-03-25 --reason="canary-thresholds"`.

Maya Torres: QA will run `./ci/smoke --canary=8` before the hold. If >3 failures, we halt.

LegalBot: legal ok — included two-line EU data note in RN.

Ravi Patel: internal announce copy for #all-hands:

```
Heads-up: Deployment tonight 23:30 UTC (8% canary). Highlights: streaming fix, model pins, and additive embedding metadata. Expected progression: 8% -> hold @00:00 UTC -> promote to broader rollout if healthy.
```

Alex Kim: ack. I'll watch p95/p99 and embedding invalids.

Maya Torres: ack. will trigger smoke and post results.

Ravi Patel: final checklist: legal ok, deploy scheduled, rollback owner named, dashboards pinned, SDK notified. Posting T-2h unless objections.

Alex Kim: no objections. ready to act.

DeployBot: standing by for `deploybot promote` or `deploybot rollback`.

Ravi Patel: thanks all — moving to post in T-2h. Reaction: :tada:
